name: AX actions
code: const state=await tab.getAXState({emit:false,disableDiffing:true}); const nameIndex=Number(state.match(/(\d+) text field[^\n]*Description: Name,/)[1]); await tab.setValue(nameIndex,"AX value"); await tab.getAXState({emit:false}); await tab.typeText(nameIndex," typed"); await tab.pressKey(nameIndex,"End"); await tab.getAXState({emit:false});

name: file chooser
code: const chooserPromise=tab.playwright.waitForEvent("filechooser",{timeoutMs:3000}); await tab.playwright.getByRole("button",{name:"Upload single",exact:true}).click(); const chooser=await chooserPromise; nodeRepl.write(chooser.isMultiple()); await chooser.setFiles(["/Users/kihoon/Documents/Codex/2026-10-01-mcp/browser-agent-bridge/tests/fixture/sample.txt"]);

name: download
code: const downloadPromise=tab.playwright.waitForEvent("download",{timeoutMs:4000}); await tab.playwright.getByRole("link",{name:"Download sample",exact:true}).click(); const download=await downloadPromise; nodeRepl.write(await download.path());

name: confirm dialog
code: await tab.playwright.getByRole("button",{name:"Confirm",exact:true}).click(); await tab.playwright.waitForTimeout(600); const confirmDialog=await tab.getJsDialog(); nodeRepl.write(confirmDialog?.type); await confirmDialog.accept();

name: prompt dialog
code: await tab.playwright.getByRole("button",{name:"Prompt",exact:true}).click(); await tab.playwright.waitForTimeout(600); const promptDialog=await tab.getJsDialog(); await promptDialog.accept("Bridge prompt");

name: alert dialog
code: await tab.playwright.getByRole("button",{name:"Alert",exact:true}).click(); await tab.playwright.waitForTimeout(600); const alertDialog=await tab.getJsDialog(); await alertDialog.dismiss();

name: navigation
code: await tab.playwright.expectNavigation(()=>tab.playwright.getByRole("button",{name:"Next page",exact:true}).click(),{url:"http://127.0.0.1:29653/next.html",timeoutMs:2500}); await tab.back(); await tab.forward(); await tab.reload(); await tab.back();

name: mark lifecycle
code: await tab.markHandoff(); await tab.markDeliverable();

name: screenshot artifact
code: await nodeRepl.emitImage(await tab.screenshot({fullPage:false}));

name: cleanup
code: await tab.close();
